resources.string: Rebuild Edge combines OpenCV preprocessing, COLMAP reconstruction, and task tracking in one place.
- OpenCV: select imagery, prep metadata, then hand the folder to COLMAP.
- COLMAP: tune reconstruction settings and watch the sparse/dense outputs.
- Tasks: review previous runs, explore logs, and validate deliverables.
Use this view to monitor a run: check the timer, CPU usage, and the latest logs as the pipeline executes.
- Preparation: copy the selected images into cache, pick stride/window, and enable GPS alignment.
- Execution: COLMAP and OpenCV steps stream text into the log and update elapsed time.
- Review: result folders land under the app-specific output directory for visualization.
